title: Stability and Chaotic Dynamics in a Nonlinearly Confined ghost-sector Hamiltonian
summary: We investigate the nonlinear dynamics of a Hamiltonian system containing a ghost degree of freedom coupled to a canonical sector through nonlinear interactions. The model consists of one positive-energy and one negative-energy mode, augmented by quartic and sextic nonlinearities that regularize the large-amplitude behavior of the system.
